name: live-v18-import-and-ownership
objective: v2.3 replan V18 on a real SillyTavern (no model needed). (1) S1: importing `placeholder-enums.story.json` as JSON, the way campaign stories reach a chat, journals `story imported with 5 warning(s)` naming the five latching placeholder qualities and not the non-latching control, and the story still plays. (2) R8: a lorebook made OUTSIDE the wizard (standing in for one of the user's own) and a character card the wizard then creates under the same name: the wizard must not treat the card as owning the book, so an entry write into it is refused and the book is left untouched. Cleanup runs in the runner's finally (`assets remove --marker SO-V18`): it deletes the card and the book, so run 2 no longer refuses on run 1's card (T7 suite 2026-10-03). Before the card is created, a group chat that still carries a selected character (ST's this_chid, left by a solo-chat hop: openGroupById resets it only when the group changes, group-chats.js:2032-2034) has it cleared, because getCharacters() re-selects that character after a card is created (script.js:1316-1320) and leaves the group: the T7 no-model lane read that as a sandbox escape to a solo Luke chat.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const events = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.summary.startsWith('story imported with')); if (rt.getSnapshot().storyId !== 'placeholder-enums') throw new Error(`the story is not playing: ${rt.getSnapshot().storyId}`); if (events.length !== 1) throw new Error(`expected one import-warning record, got ${events.length}`); const detail = JSON.stringify(events[0].detail ?? {}); const named = ['verdict', 'allegiance', 'oath', 'wound', 'pay'].filter((key) => detail.includes(`'${key}'`)); if (events[0].summary !== 'story imported with 5 warning(s)' || named.length !== 5 || detail.includes(`'route'`)) throw new Error(`wrong warnings: ${events[0].summary} ${detail}`); return { summary: events[0].summary, named, storyId: rt.getSnapshot().storyId };

const pre = SillyTavern.getContext(); let staleCharacter = null; if (pre.groupId && pre.characterId !== undefined && pre.characterId !== null) { staleCharacter = pre.characters?.[pre.characterId]?.name ?? String(pre.characterId); (await import('/script.js')).setCharacterId(undefined); } if (SillyTavern.getContext().characterId !== undefined) throw new Error('a group chat is open with a selected character, and creating a card reloads the characters, which re-selects it and leaves the group: ' + staleCharacter); const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); const name = 'SO-V18 Harbour'; await wi.updateWorldInfoList(); if (!(SillyTavern.getContext().getWorldInfoNames?.() ?? []).includes(name)) { const made = await wi.createNewWorldInfo(name, { interactive: false }); if (!made) throw new Error('could not create the stand-in user book'); } await wi.updateWorldInfoList(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const draft = { id: 'so-v18-owner', title: 'SO-V18 Owner', requirements: { lorebooks: [name] } }; const card = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'createCharacterCard', name, description: 'A harbour master, created by the V18 check.' }, draft); if (!card.ok) throw new Error(`the card was not created: ${card.message}`); const env = rt.getProvisioningEnvironment(draft); const session = rt.getWizardSession('so-v18-owner'); return { card: card.message, owned: env.ownedLorebooks, applied: session?.applied, createdLorebooks: session?.createdLorebooks, staleCharacterCleared: staleCharacter };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const name = 'SO-V18 Harbour'; const draft = { id: 'so-v18-owner', title: 'SO-V18 Owner', requirements: { lorebooks: [name] } }; const env = rt.getProvisioningEnvironment(draft); if (env.ownedLorebooks.some((book) => book.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase())) throw new Error(`the card made the wizard own the user's book: ${JSON.stringify(env.ownedLorebooks)}`); const write = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'upsertLorebookEntry', lorebook: name, comment: 'Harbour dues', keys: ['dues'], content: 'Written by the V18 check; must never land.' }, draft); const book = await (await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: SillyTavern.getContext().getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name }), cache: 'no-cache' })).json(); const entries = Object.values(book.entries ?? {}); if (write.ok) throw new Error(`the wizard wrote into a book it does not own: ${write.message}`); if (entries.length) throw new Error(`the book gained ${entries.length} entry/entries`); return { refused: true, message: write.message, entries: entries.length };
